description: Move catalog for the VPG Engine. Each move is an attack, submission, taunt, or other action that can be assigned to slots in move-slots.json. 'slot_ids' lists the slots the move is actually eligible for and is what the engine resolves against; 'groups' records the slot groups it was drawn from, and is always a superset - a move may belong to a group but be excluded from some of its slots.

field_definitions.move_id: snake_case identifier. NOT globally unique - the same move_id may appear in different positions, and may appear more than once within a position as a deliberate variant (a weaker and a stronger version of the same move).
field_definitions.name: Display name.
field_definitions.position: The state the wrestler is in when the move is available.
field_definitions.groups: Slot group ids from move-slots.json that this move was drawn from. Descriptive: eligibility is decided by slot_ids, which may be a strict subset.
field_definitions.slot_ids: Authoritative list of slot ids from move-slots.json that this move can fill.
field_definitions.power: Power grade S (highest) through G (lowest), or null for moves that do no damage.
field_definitions.ko: Whether the move can knock the opponent out.
field_definitions.bleed: Whether the move can draw blood.
field_definitions.actor_animation_id: Animation clip id for the actor, or null while the move is unanimated.
field_definitions.target_animation_id: Animation clip id for the target, or null while the move is unanimated.
field_definitions.slot_animation_overrides: Overrides for the slot animation, if any. Format: 'slot_id:animation_id;slot_id:animation_id;...'.
